project_type: React 19 SPA with Vite 6 and TypeScript 5.6
test_framework: No test framework configured - validation is via TypeScript compilation
verification_instructions: Run `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) to confirm zero TypeScript errors and successful bundle
contribution_requirements: All pages use static mock data, no API calls, no randomness. Dark theme with dark-bg (#0f1117), dark-surface (#1a1b2e), dark-card (#1e2035) tokens.
key_patterns: Pages are single-file components in src/pages/. They import Card from @/components/common/Card. They use lucide-react for icons, recharts for charts. Layout pattern: flex gap-4 with flex-1 main content and w-80 sidebar. Mock data is defined as const arrays at the top of the file. Table rows use Card padding='none' wrapper. Text sizing: text-2xl for page titles, text-sm for subtitles/descriptions, text-[10px] for metadata/timestamps. Color coding: green for success, red for errors/high, orange for medium/warnings, blue for info/active states.
relevant_files: src/pages/Activity.tsx (pattern reference - similar layout with sidebar, table, donut chart)
directory_structure: dashboard/src/pages/ contains all page components; dashboard/src/components/common/ has shared components like Card
